post.description:
Foreign currency (M3): give `currency` other than the company's with line amounts in that currency; the server converts at a stored rate (`rateId`), a manual rate (`manualRate`, stored and audited) or the looked-up rate (transaction date, else the latest earlier daily rate within 7 days, else 422 `exchange_rate_not_found`). Each line is rounded per line, half-up, to the company currency; a visible FX-rounding line absorbs up to one minor unit per line. Opening balances and control adjustments are posted in the company currency only.

**Requires permission:** `journal:post`

info.title: UK Accounting Platform API
info.description:
Practice-first accounting, tax and compliance platform. **V0 foundation:** identity, tenancy, RBAC, documents, jobs, audit, outbox events, workflows, tasks, notifications, integration and AI abstractions.

All tenant data lives under `/organisations/{organisationId}` and is protected by authentication, RBAC, company scope and PostgreSQL row-level security. Errors use RFC 9457 `application/problem+json`.
